name: io.github.mharnett/meta-ads-incrementality
description: Meta Ads MCP built on incrementality: incremental vs 7d-click/1d-view conversions, side by side.

environmentVariables.name: META_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Meta Marketing API access token (a System User token is recommended). Needed unless you have cached an OAuth token with mcp-meta-ads-auth.

environmentVariables.name: META_ADS_MCP_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose the tools that change an account. Unset, the server is read-only.
